name: Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker
summary: Zorbin’s Ultra-Shrinker is a goblin device used on giants along Feralas’s western coast. Zorbin Fandazzle studies the residue left behind and values the goodwill it earns among his Steamwheedle Cartel friends.

sections.title: A Goblin Device
sections.body: At the Forgotten Coast docks, Zorbin Fandazzle puts his Ultra-Shrinker to work on Feralas’s giants. The device reduces them to a more manageable form, leaving residue for his research. Zorbin welcomes more of it, and says the service carries word of your work to his goblin friends in the Steamwheedle Cartel.

faq.answer: Zorbin’s Ultra-Shrinker reduces giants in Feralas to a more manageable form and leaves residue for his research.
Zorbin Fandazzle is a goblin at the Forgotten Coast docks in Feralas who studies residue from shrunken giants.

faq.q: Where does Zorbin use the device?
faq.answer: Zorbin Fandazzle is at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, and the giants he studies are along Feralas’s western coast.

faq.q: Why does Zorbin want the residue?
faq.answer: Zorbin studies Miniaturization Residue, which is left by giants reduced with his Ultra-Shrinker.

faq.q: What does Zorbin offer for helping him?
aliases: what do i get from zorbin
faq.answer: Zorbin offers coin and says he will spread word of your service among his goblin friends in the Steamwheedle Cartel.

angles.text: As an engineer, you may appreciate Zorbin’s goblin device, built to shrink Feralas’s giants for study.
